items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 如遇失道旷野之难，路遭贼人之难，水火刀兵之难，鬼神药毒之难，恶兽毒虫之难，冤家恶人之难，便呼我名。「三眼五显仙人」——「魈」，听召前来守护。
items.text_en: If you awake to a knife at your throat, if monsters dig their claws into you, if death comes knocking at your door... Call out my name. Adeptus Xiao. I will be here when you call.

items.title: 闲聊·闲散
items.text: 我居然沦落到如此闲散的地步，可笑。
items.text_en: Reduced to just standing around... How absurd.

items.title: 闲聊·荒魂
items.text: 荒野上的孤魂，休想伤我分毫。
items.text_en: The damned will sooner die again than lay a hand on me.

items.title: 闲聊·侵蚀
items.text: …呃啊…哼，想起了一些不愉快的事。
items.text_en: Grrgh... Those memories, so dark...

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 魔物不会因为下雨就休息。我们走。
items.text_en: Demons do not stop for the rain. Move.

items.title: 雨过天晴
items.text: 天晴了？哼，我不关心天气。
items.text_en: The rain stopped? I don't concern myself with the weather.

items.title: 打雷的时候
items.text: 不少凡人害怕打雷。无法理解，这分明很寻常。
items.text_en: Many mortals fear lightning... Incomprehensible. Fear of something so common.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 雪积起来之后，就可以挖着吃了。
items.text_en: Once the snow is thick enough, we can eat it...

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 时候不早了。出发吧。
items.text_en: We're wasting time. Let's go.

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 午餐…回望舒客栈吧。
items.text_en: Lunch... We'll go back to Wangshu Inn.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 夜晚，不祥之物最易骚动。你最好别出门。
items.text_en: Night... When the darkness comes to envelop you. Don't stay outside.

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 你去吧，我会在这里等你。
items.text_en: Go. I'll be here.

items.title: 关于魈自己·非人
items.text: 我并非人类，不太能够理解人类的感情。
items.text_en: I'm far from human. I can't make much of human emotions.

items.title: 关于魈自己·璃月
items.text: 近来璃月变化得过于迅速了…呵，罢了，我也没打算适应。
items.text_en: Liyue is changing. Rapidly... Forget it. It means nothing to me.

items.title: 关于我们·警示
items.text: 如果有一天，连你也陷入了黑暗。就由我来——
items.text_en: If a day comes where even you are taken by the darkness, it will be up to me...

items.title: 关于我们·信任
items.text: 别被污染，我不会留情的。…我是说，既然是「你」，「你」应该能够保持坚定。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Do not fall prey to the darkness. I have no mercy.Though, perhaps you can stand your ground alone.

items.title: 关于我们·犯困
items.text: …谁！？…你觉得我是站着睡着了？哼，不敬仙师！
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Who's there? Oh... You think I sleep? You have no respect for the ways of the adepti.

items.title: 关于我们·海灯节
items.text: 海灯节？哼，原来又到了凡人用发光垃圾塞满璃月港的时候了，唉，为何如此幼稚。不过你若无聊，我便陪你去。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6The Lantern Rite? The time for humans to discard their glowing trash into the sea has returned... How childish...Though, if you insist... I will go with you.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」·欲望
items.text: 「神之眼」、欲望？呵…不要用凡人的标准来揣测仙人，我没有欲望。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Visions? Desire? Ha. Do not judge adepti by your mortal ideals. I have no desire.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」·理由
items.text: 并不是有意隐瞒。我的欲望，不应对外人讲。人间不是有着愿望说出口就会失效的规矩…呃，不是一回事？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Hiding? I'm hiding nothing. I just won't speak of desire to others.Do you mortals not have a rule about spoken wishes never coming true? Hm? What do you mean that's not the same?

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 杀戮是我的强项。如果你下不去手，就叫我来。
items.text_en: I deal in death. If you cannot bring yourself to kill — speak my name.

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 荻花洲，曾经一度荒芜。虽然，是过去好多年…不，好几百年的事了。
items.text_en: Dihua Islet was once deserted.Though that was many decades... no, centuries ago...

items.title: 关于钟离
items.text: 嗯…打听一下。请问钟离大人平日里都在…呃，遛鸟？赏花？品鉴古玩？…钟离大人做这些，是有什么深意…
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "A New Star Approaches"Can I ask... Zhongli — what does he do with his days? Huh? Birds, antiques, flowers...Hmm... What deeper meaning do they hold?

items.title: 关于北斗
items.text: 北斗吗？我与她没有什么交情。不过，冥海巨兽确有其事。能够将「海山」击败，作为人类，她的实力值得肯定。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Beidou? I have nothing to do with her. Though there is such a thing as the leviathan. As a mere human, she has proven her power in defeating Haishan.

items.title: 关于白术
items.text: 你想…托付白术研制缓解我痛苦的药物？呵…你的好意我心领了。凡人的药物，对仙人是无法起效的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4You want... Baizhu to make a medicine to take away my pain? I understand your intentions, but mortal medicine has no effect on adepti.

items.title: 关于胡桃
items.text: 胡桃？那孩子，活泼到令人头疼。所幸她还算风趣，不必担心会成长为无趣的人类。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Hu Tao? Her liveliness is irritating. Fortunately, she is also humorous, so you need not worry about her growing into a boring human.

items.title: 关于温迪
items.text: 温迪…？原来如此，名字叫作温迪啊。他演奏的曲调…不，没什么。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Venti? So that's the name he goes by. His tunes are... forget it.

items.title: 关于甘雨
items.text: 甘雨既非仙兽，又非凡人，游走于仙人两界，靠着职责支撑自我，困惑是免不了的。...你说，我？呵，要让只懂杀戮与生存之道的夜叉，去开导瑞兽？天方夜谭。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Ganyu is neither mortal nor illuminated beast. Wandering both the mortal and adepti realms with duty as her sole guide, it was inevitable that she would become perplexed... What? Me? You believe a yaksha who knows nothing more than how to massacre countless souls and emerge unscathed is a suitable mentor for such an individual? ...Your mind occupies a very different world from that which your body inhabits.

items.title: 关于申鹤
items.text: 申鹤似乎对你颇为信赖。…也是。毕竟，世间难得几人能有你这般的善心与热忱。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Complete "The Crane Returns on the Wind"It seems Shenhe places a great deal of trust in you. Well, how could she not. There are few people in the world as kind and good-natured as you.

items.title: 关于夜兰
items.text: 我听说她曾调查千岩军在层岩巨渊的相关痕迹。孤身追查秘密，想来也是有点本事的人。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4I've heard that she once investigated The Chasm, following the trail of the Millelith. If she can investigate mysteries like that on her own, she must be someone of rare skill.

items.title: 想要了解魈·其一
items.text: 我会为你护法。但是…别靠近我，别妨碍我。否则，你会后悔的。
items.text_en: I'm willing to protect you.But don't think about getting close, and stay out of my way, or all that awaits you is regret.

items.title: 想要了解魈·其二
items.text: 在这千年以来，我猎杀过数以万计的怨魂。不想惹上麻烦，就离我远点。把我当作「工具」就好。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3In the thousands of years that have passed, I have taken countless wraiths. If you want no trouble, stay away from me. See me as a weapon, and nothing more.

items.title: 想要了解魈·其三
items.text: 「它们」的声音…常常在我的耳边出现。咆哮、号哭…嘶喊着杀戮…这是我自己的选择和自己的报应。与你无关。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Their voices... I can always hear them. Their screams, their cries, demanding more death...This is my burden to carry. It has nothing to do with you.

items.title: 想要了解魈·其四
items.text: 摩拉克斯？关于这个名字，你究竟知道多少？他是赐予我「魈」之名之人，将我从漫长的痛苦中解放。胆敢对他不敬的话。即使是你，我也不会原谅。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Morax...? What do you know of this name!?He gave me the name Xiao, and released me from the endless pain I endured.I will not forgive those that dare to speak against him, even you.

items.title: 想要了解魈·其五
items.text: 已经迟了。我们之间的关联已经太多了。即使你想要放弃，也来不及了吧。嗯？没有这样想过？…「靖妖傩舞」，我的战斗是不会停下的。但是，关于你的事情，我想了解更多。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6It's too late. The connection between us is too strong. Even if you wanted to, it's too late to sever it. Hm? You've never thought to sever it?*sigh* This eternal dance of demon subjugation... My fight goes on.But, I would like to know more about you.

items.title: 魈的爱好
items.text: 你还真是胆量不小，有勇气询问我的爱好。那便来战吧。以你的身躯，扛得住我几招呢？
items.text_en: There's nothing timid about you, having the courage to ask about my hobbies.So, fight me. How long do you think your body will last against my blows?

items.title: 魈的烦恼
items.text: 烦恼？呵…这个问题对仙人毫无意义，没有什么烦恼能够存在千年。
items.text_en: Trouble? Ha. Trouble means nothing to adepti. There is no trouble that can last for a thousand years.

items.title: 喜欢的食物·杏仁豆腐
items.text: 我对人间的食物并无兴致。烹饪繁琐，等待漫长。唯独杏仁豆腐，勉强可以入口。
items.text_en: I have no interest in mortal food. Cooking is tedious and the wait is long. The one thing I can manage to stomach is almond tofu.

items.title: 喜欢的食物·回忆
items.text: 杏仁豆腐的味道，和「美梦」非常相似呢。
items.text_en: The taste of Almond Tofu feels like a fond dream...

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 要我亲手在薄饼中包入肉片？啊…然后…一起吃下去？呵…麻烦。如今的人间，真是越来越缺乏常识了。
items.text_en: Wait. I am expected to place slices of meat in wrappings myself? And then... eat them? Together? Ugh, humans these days do not know what they are doing.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 嗯，不错…为什么要盯着我看。
items.text_en: Mm... Not bad... Why are you staring at me?

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 不用麻烦。
items.text_en: No need.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 下次做点别的吧。
items.text_en: Try something else next time.

items.title: 生日
items.text: 诞生的时日…人类的这些纪念，真是冗余。嗯…等着。我给你折一只梧桐树叶蝴蝶。好了，拿去吧。这是仙法，可以辟邪。
items.text_en: This mortal concept of commemorating the day of your birth really is redundant. Ahem. Wait. Uhh, have this. It's a butterfly I made from leaves.Okay. Take it. It's an adepti amulet — it staves off evil.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 只是这种程度而已。没什么值得大惊小怪的。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 1This is it? Nothing worth getting excited about.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 新的力量？这力量，也只会被用于斩杀。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 2New power? All it will be used for is death.

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 力量的尽头，是自我毁灭。回答我，为何如此执着呢？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 4The limit to one's power is self-destruction. Answer me. Why do you persist?

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 我的枪缨，早就屠戮了无尽的怨魂。连我本人，不免也被黑暗吞噬。——你却敢于驱使这样的我，将我当作…「同伴」。…你是想要救赎我吗？…你，真是难以理解的生物。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Ascension Phase 6Countless souls have fallen prey to these hands. I too have been swallowed by the darkness — and yet you dare to drive me on. You may think of me as... your companion. You seek to find me salvation? ...You... really are a difficult being to comprehend.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 哼。
items.text_en: Hmph.

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 无聊。
items.text_en: Boring.

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 无用。
items.text_en: Useless.

items.title: 下落攻击·其一
items.text: 这里！
items.text_en: Here!

items.title: 下落攻击·其二
items.text: 无能。
items.text_en: Worthless!

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 就此消失。
items.text_en: Disappear!

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 靖妖傩舞。
items.text_en: Evil conquering!

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 悲鸣吧。
items.text_en: Lament!

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 对你有用便好。
items.text_en: If it's useful, I'll take it.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 这些物品的用途…算了，我不关心。
items.text_en: Why would anyone want... *sigh* Forget it, it's not my concern.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 嗯…品质尚可。
items.text_en: Hmph... there's quality here.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 住口。
items.text_en: Shut it.

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 愚蠢。
items.text_en: Prepare to die, fool!

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 很好。
items.text_en: *grunts* Good.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: …弱小。
items.text_en: ...Weak.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 想活命，就退后。
items.text_en: Get back if you wanna survive.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 这是…报应吗。
items.text_en: Is this... retribution?

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 这一天…到来了呀。
items.text_en: The day... has finally come.

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 不可能…
items.text_en: Impossible...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 就凭你？
items.text_en: That's it?

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 别妨碍我。
items.text_en: Ugh, get out of my way!

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 听召而来。
items.text_en: You called?

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 诸邪退散。
items.text_en: Evil shall be dispersed.

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 降魔乃分内之事。
items.text_en: Conquering demons is what I do.
